headline_marked: Mymensingh court [[sentences two brothers to death]] for murdering schoolboy
headline: Mymensingh court sentences two brothers to death for murdering schoolboy
summary: The 10th-grade student was killed in 2021 after his relationship with a girl was opposed by her family.
details: A Mymensingh court has sentenced two brothers, Nazmul Haque and Enamul Haque, to death for the murder of Saikat Hasan Akash, a tenth-grade schoolboy.
The crime took place in May 2021, when Akash was lured out by a girl and killed after her family opposed his romantic relationship with her.
Additional District and Sessions Judge (Acting) Md Samsuddin delivered the verdict on Thursday afternoon.
In addition to the death sentences, the victim's father, Ziaul Haque, and uncle, Julhas Uddin, were sentenced to seven years of rigorous imprisonment each.
The court also fined the four convicts a total of Tk 80,000, with additional jail time if the payment is not made.
Police recovered the victim's body on May 21, 2021, two days after he was killed and buried.
The investigation revealed that Saikat, a student at Ashtadhar High School, was in a relationship with the daughter of a local union council member.
While Nazmul, Ziaul, and Julhas were present in court, Enamul remains absconding.

The court also fined the four convicts a total of Tk 80,000, with additional jail time if the payment is not made.

Police recovered the victim's body on May 21, 2021, two days after he was killed and buried.

The investigation revealed that Saikat, a student at Ashtadhar High School, was in a relationship with the daughter of a local union council member.

headline_marked: 20 million people to attend [[Khamenei's funeral in Iran]], history's largest
headline: 20 million people to attend Khamenei's funeral in Iran, history's largest
summary: Iran is preparing for what is expected to be the largest funeral in history, with an estimated 20 million people participating.
details: Iran is making preparations for the funeral of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, which is expected to be the largest in history.
Approximately 20 million people are expected to participate in the funeral rites
The event is being organized as a massive scale operation to honor the leader's passing.
Preparations are underway to manage the crowds and ensure the funeral proceedings are carried out on a grand scale.
